content: Yɛsu kan'bilà u Yɛlusàlɛm
Umpal bàsin ba tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, anà bàtöl ba tsütsü a Bɛtefazɛ, udu a mɔŋ a In'te a olive, apan Yɛsu kàtöm abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a alɔŋki ande,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen u bul lanà kusà a bɛ, pa làkàkɔlà bɛ, bɛ làkàman ntsür bàfàbel anɛs wàŋàbäm un'siŋ anà mwan awa ukɔl. Làtsuuŋ wa, lan'twääl ayà pà.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn undiir anà bɛ, lun'fuur naa: "Mwol we anà mfun aya". Làgyägyä, ba bàyàwɛy ya ntɔn mukyà. »
Yàkäl ya abà, ntɔn ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm yi ikwe:

content.text: « Tɛn a un'sɛŋ a Siyɔnà naa:
Le, mfum angye wàmuyà akà ngye,
wàŋàyɔl a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà wàŋàlaar udu a ntsür bàfàbel an, anà udu anɔ, mwan a ntsür afàsyen buur. »

content: Alɔŋki bàkyen ba, ba bàkyer asànaa kaswɛŋ Yɛsu.
Ba bàtwääl ntsür bàfàbel an anà mwan awa, waa bàyɛɛl ipfɛy aba udu a ya. Yɛsu kàbwaay udu a ya.
Un'sɛŋ a baar kàyɛɛl ipfɛy awa u mbwo, bumwɛy bàtsüülà an'kɔkà a in'te waa bàyɛɛlà ma u mbwo.
In'sɛŋ a baar myàyikyeenà kusà a Yɛsu anà myàyun'labà myàkäl muyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: « Ɔsana akà Mwan a David! Wɛy mbuur awà ayà kà ikɔb a Mwol ukäl wàŋàsaak! Ɔsana kà ikal a dudu! »
Mpal kàbilà nde u Yɛlusàlɛm, bul lanswà làkyer ani anà làkäl mufuulà naa: « Nà wawà? »
In'sɛŋ waa myàfuurà naa: « Ŋangɔɔm Yɛsu, un'nsi Nasàlɛr u Ngalilɛ. »
Yɛsu uboo a ndwà a Nzam
Yɛsu kàbilà u làpaŋ a ndwà a Nzam, nde kàböŋ atɛɛl a an'yà banswà bàkäl kwo, kàbuum mɛsà a agyɛɛŋ a ngim anà an'kir a ayääl a an'yem.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bàsön naa: "Ndwà amɛ bàsabeelà naa ndwà a ngyamàkà", wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ ya làkyàbuul mboo a mbüüb! »
Ikwàmii anà ikar bàyàsin tsütsü apà nde uboo a ndwà a Nzam, nde waa kakɔɔr.
Wɛɛ mpal bàmɛn andweer a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn ndaa impà kàkyer Yɛsu anà in'kwɛŋ bàsyee baan uboo a ndwà a Nzam: « Ɔsana akà Mwan a David! », ba bàwem nkyɛl,

waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkye ngye akiweemà ndaa bàtɛɛnà ba? » Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Inye. Nkye bɛ, bɛ làtäŋ anki akà ikikye ndaa bàsön yi: "Nkye ngye kàyöŋà nsyäŋà u mun a ambɛy anà yà baan abà kà an'bɛɛl?" »
Apan laa kàsawɛy nde, waa kàkyen Bɛtani, ntsü kàkàbɔ̈ɔ̈n nde.
Yɛsu kan'küül un'te a an'fige
Taaŋtyà ututu, mpal kàkäl nde u mbwo mufurà bul a kölàköl, Yɛsu kàwem ngyal.

Nde kàmɛn un'te a an'fige ukɔl a mbwo, nde kàsin tsütsü apà wa, wɛɛ nde undiir kàmɛn anki, nà nkay mpɛl. Apan nde kàtɛn a un'te naa: « Ngye afàsàbɔr anki imbɛŋ! » Taaŋ nsil alan, un'te laa kàyöm wa.
Mpal bàmɛn alɔŋki abun, ba bàkyer abem, waa bàtɛn naa: « Un'te a an'fige kan'yɔm aben u mbalà mwɛy? »

Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mɛ, mɛ ndandaa alàkyään: isàkal naa bɛ làbye anà làkwikilà, ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr, bɛ lan'kwo mukyer kànà ndaa an'kyer mɛ yi akà un'te wà anki, wɛ bɛ lan'kwo mutɛn itàkal a mɔŋ wà naa: "Lwomà pà, kyen kabü u ngyäl", ya sye ikal abun.
Undiir wanswà làlɔm bɛ unsà làkwikilà u ngyamàkà, bɛ làkyer asàwal wa. »
Ikɔ̈b a Yɛsu kyan'fà ken?
Mpal kàbilà Yɛsu u ndwà a Nzam, amfum a angaŋ anà andweer a un'sɛŋ bàyàsin anà bun'fuul umpal kàkäl nde mulɔŋ: « Unsà ikɔ̈b nà ayikyer ngye indiir abi? Nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b aki? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mɛ sye in'we anà mfuul mwɛy ntɔn bɛ. Isàkal naa bɛ làman'pà mfuur, mɛ sye waa alakyään naa unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà bya.
Ndüümà a Ywan yàfü ken? U du lɛɛ akà baar? » Wɛɛ ba bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba naa: « Kya bi isàtɛn naa: "U du", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'si bɛ làkwikilà?"
Wɛɛ bi isàfuur naa: "Baar", bi itiin un'sɛŋ a baar bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba banswà bàkyàyöb naa Ywan wà ŋangɔɔm. »
Apan, ba bàfuur akà Yɛsu naa: « Bi iyöb anki. » Waa nde sye kafuur naa: « Mɛ sye alàkyään anki unsà ikɔ̈b nà in'fàkyer mɛ indiir abi. »
Nsim a baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l
« An'kyän abɛ mye aben? Mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà baan abaal bɔ̈ɔ̈l. Nde kàsin apà wàtàtwɛb, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: "Mwan amɛ, kyen kasäl ŋàbà u ywaŋ a vin."
Mwan awà kàfuur naa: "Aay, mɛ in'kwen anki." Ungö a taaŋ, nde kàsɔɔm ankyän, waa kàkyen.
Kàsin nde apà mwan wàyweel, nde kàtɛn ndaa nsil ya. Mwan awà kàfuur naa: "Inye, taa". Wɛɛ nde kàkyen anki.

Nà uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l kàkyer ukwen a taarànde? » Ba naa: « Wàtàtwɛb. » Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: afüür a itɛr anà akaar a pasàsɛ bàsàfwel kusà a bɛ uboo a Imwol a Nzam.

Ntɔn Ywan kàyi akà bɛ u mbwo a balàbal, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làkwikilà lun'si anki. Wɛɛ afüür a itɛr anà akaar a pasàsɛ bun'si làkwikilà. Itàkal naa bɛ làkyàman ya abwɛy, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làbuul anki mpem ntɔn mukun'sà làkwikilà.
Nsim a baar a isal abe
« Làwem nsim yumwɛy: Nkum mwɛy kàkön vin u ywaŋ. Nde kàdiŋà la a làpaŋ, nde kàtöŋ ikal mukaam mbɛŋ anà ndwà a ikyɛɛŋ. Ungö apan nde kàpɛ la akà atɛɛr a man, waa kàkyen mukàyilyaŋ.
Mpal làkwe taaŋ abwo mbɛŋ, nde kàtöm asyääl ande akà atɛɛr a man ntɔn muwal mbɛŋ a vin.
Atɛɛr a man bàkör asyääl aban, umwɛy bun'düb, umwɛy bun'dwä, umwɛy bun'käm in'kul.
Nde kàfàtɔm asyääl asin mbɔɔn bàŋàlyaŋ bàtàtwɛb, wɛɛ atɛɛr a man bakyer ifà imwɛy kya.
Mumay, nde kàtöm mwan ande, waa kàtɛn naa: "Ba bàyàkàkömà mwan amɛ."
Wɛɛ mpal bàmɛn atɛɛr a man mwan awà, ba bàtɛn ba a ba naa: "Le ikyee ande. Làyi bi kun'dwä, waa bi iwal ywaŋ ande!"
Apan, ba bun'tɛ mpi, bun'tɔɔm u nsà a ywaŋ a vin, waa bun'dwä. »
Abun, Yɛsu kafuul naa: « Ŋàbawà, ŋaywaŋ asàkyer aben ntɔn atɛɛr a man abà? »
Ba bun'fuur naa: « Nde baar abe abà akyer asadwa ukɔɔn aman ngyɛb, nde asàwal ywaŋ a vin, waa usàpà la akà atɛɛr a man asin ban'kwo mukun'pà mbɛŋ u taaŋ a taaŋ. »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki akà ikikye uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn:

content.text: ya yàbulà nkɔŋ a twɛrà a ndwà.
ndaa mwɛy yubem u mii abi!" »

content: « Mɛ, mɛ in'fàlakyään naa: Imwol a Nzam bàkyer asàladuum, waa bàsàpà akà un'sɛŋ awà asàbɔr mbɛŋ.
[ Mbuur asàbwà udu a nkɔŋ ayi akyer asàpàpää, anà ya isàbweel mbuur, mbuur awun akyer asàbwàbwamà. » ]
Mpal bàwem andweer a angaŋ anà Amfarisi nsim ande ayi, ba bàkyer ayöb naa nde kàtɛɛnà a ba.
Undiir awun, bàleŋà ba ipöl mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà a iköŋ a baar byàwɛlà Yɛsu asànaa ŋangɔɔm.
